Requirement: AI usable by end users at the ruled default
Whats_Missing: A lawful provider path. Claude Code subscription auth may not serve other people - the file says so itself at :80
Why_It_Matters: Without it the AI layer refuses for every user INCLUDING the owner, because the guard fires before the identity check and AI_PROVIDER defaults to the restricted provider

Requirement: Whether the AI acted must be recoverable
Whats_Missing: Any persisted evidence a model touched a business write. executor is hardcoded to software; the ai value is never assigned
Why_It_Matters: The 95/5 split CANNOT be measured by counting model calls - 0 calls is exactly what a switched-off AI produces, so success and absence read identically

Requirement: A cited test must prove the requirement
Whats_Missing: A CI-outcome condition in the gate. Six requirements cite a spec that does not execute
Why_It_Matters: A register quoted as evidence must not say true where its own proof does not run. 51 is not defensible; 42 is

Requirement: Every API route must call requireAuth()
Whats_Missing: Nothing - CLOSED by R81. The check existed but was never wired AND would not have worked
Why_It_Matters: A vacuously-green check is worse than none, because it is quoted as proof

Requirement: Tenant data must not leak between orgs
Whats_Missing: An enforced guarantee. Next caches on URL+method+body NOT headers; held shut only by cache:no-store repeated at four call sites
Why_It_Matters: Blast radius is every proxied read for every tenant, and the trigger is an ordinary performance edit

Requirement: Atomic financial operations must not split
Whats_Missing: Either the sites fixed or the production behaviour changed - the latter is an owner decision
Why_It_Matters: assertNotNested THROWS in dev but only warns in PRODUCTION. The loud dev failure was the SAFE manifestation

Requirement: The AI audit row required by the constitution
Whats_Missing: The audit row. Called inside seven live transactions, it degrades to a skipped log line and swallows its own failure
Why_It_Matters: An AI action completing with no audit record is an unattributable AI action

Requirement: A locked-out user must have a recovery path
Whats_Missing: Password reset, in either product. forgot-password is a 17-line redirect to /login
Why_It_Matters: A stub that redirects reads as a working recovery path to anyone auditing the surface. Worst for a sole owner

Requirement: Four of six roles have never been exercised
Whats_Missing: Accounts for admin, pm, site_engineer, client_viewer and a screen sweep under each
Why_It_Matters: Four untested roles are four untested authorization surfaces

Requirement: Login-to-dashboard must meet its 400ms target
Location: projexa /dashboard and its five API calls
Whats_Missing: The optimisation aimed at the RIGHT code. Warm median 3716-3907ms, ~9x over target
Why_It_Matters: The prescribed remedy targets a function NOT on this route - doing it would move nothing while risking financial-redaction code

Requirement: A connector scope gate must actually gate
Whats_Missing: The gate on the live path. executeGatedConnectorAction has a full test suite and ZERO production call sites
Why_It_Matters: A security control with green tests and no call sites is worse than an absent one - the tests are read as proof it is enforced

Requirement: IMG must be measurable before it can be built on
Whats_Missing: Content, a usable vector substrate, an entitled org, and a proof mechanism for the 37 rows that have none
Why_It_Matters: Addendum C builds the IMG on this. An IMG on a refusing L1 and an unmatchable vector store measures nothing

Requirement: Append-only guarantees must bind every role
Whats_Missing: Guards binding the roles a script or MCP session actually uses, and an UPDATE guard on graph_edge
Why_It_Matters: memory_versions IS the audit trail. A guarantee holding for one role of three is not a guarantee

Requirement: A resource that lists must be openable
Whats_Missing: A working single-resource read. It served the same ids earlier the same day, so it is a regression
Why_It_Matters: It blocks VERIFICATION, not just reading - a broken instrument masquerades as a broken product

Requirement: A requirement must not be satisfied by hiding
Whats_Missing: An assertion that every rendered pill is dispatchable, so the requirement is enforced by a test not a flag
Why_It_Matters: A requirement met by hiding the failure is met until someone unhides it. One boolean re-breaks R-81 silently

Requirement: Entitlement state must not silently render wrong
Whats_Missing: The server-side race fixed, or the retry helper applied everywhere instead of at one call site
Why_It_Matters: On a raced load those pages hide modules as not-enabled and null the role, with no error and no retry

Requirement: Migrations applied must exist on a freshly built database
Whats_Missing: Journal entries for 9 DEBT files and a reconciliation between the two ledgers
Why_It_Matters: If environment 1 schema cannot be rebuilt, every green test on it proves less than it appears to

Requirement: Audit registers must not be writable by the audited process
Whats_Missing: Nothing - closed in drizzle/0573
Why_It_Matters: An audit trail the audited process can silently rewrite is not an audit trail

Requirement: R-50 project value must match BOQ total
Whats_Missing: An OWNER DECISION - withdraw R-50 as superseded, or overturn the standing ruling
Why_It_Matters: Code deliberately implements the opposite on a recorded owner ruling. Reconciling them would reintroduce the R67 D-62 three-money-stories defect

Requirement: Twelve BLOCKED requirements measure the environment not the product
Whats_Missing: A Playwright spec per requirement bound to environment 1 and green in CI
Why_It_Matters: BLOCKED looks recorded from runs against paused Vercel, so the ledger understates the product
